SELECT
    DIA,
    SUM(CADASTROS) AS CADASTROS,
    SUM(RETORNOS_ATIVO) AS RETORNOS_ATIVO,
    SUM(INADIMPLENCIAS) AS INADIMPLENCIAS,
    SUM(CANCELAMENTOS) AS CANCELAMENTOS,
    SUM(CANCELAMENTOS_INADIMPLENCIA) AS CANCELAMENTOS_INADIMPLENCIA,
    SUM(PAUSADOS) AS PAUSADOS,
    SUM(PERMUTAS) AS PERMUTAS
FROM (

    /* CADASTROS */
    SELECT
        DATE(DATA_CADASTRO) AS DIA,
        COUNT(*) AS CADASTROS,
        0 AS RETORNOS_ATIVO,
        0 AS INADIMPLENCIAS,
        0 AS CANCELAMENTOS,
        0 AS CANCELAMENTOS_INADIMPLENCIA,
        0 AS PAUSADOS,
        0 AS PERMUTAS
    FROM ALTAREDE.CLIENTE
    WHERE DATA_CADASTRO >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
    GROUP BY DATE(DATA_CADASTRO)

    UNION ALL

    /* RETORNOS PARA ATIVO */
    SELECT
        DATE(DATA_OPERACAO) AS DIA,
        0,
        COUNT(*),
        0, 0, 0, 0, 0
    FROM ALTAREDE.AUDITORIA_CLIENTE
    WHERE OBS LIKE 'ALTERAÇÃO TIPO CLIENTE%'
      AND VALOR_ATUAL = '1'
      AND VALOR_ANTERIOR <> VALOR_ATUAL
      AND DATE(DATA_OPERACAO) >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
    GROUP BY DATE(DATA_OPERACAO)

    UNION ALL

    /* INADIMPLÊNCIAS */
    SELECT
        DATE(DATA_OPERACAO) AS DIA,
        0, 0,
        COUNT(*),
        0, 0, 0, 0
    FROM ALTAREDE.AUDITORIA_CLIENTE
    WHERE OBS LIKE 'ALTERAÇÃO TIPO CLIENTE%'
      AND VALOR_ATUAL = '3'
      AND VALOR_ANTERIOR <> VALOR_ATUAL
      AND DATE(DATA_OPERACAO) >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
    GROUP BY DATE(DATA_OPERACAO)

    UNION ALL

    /* CANCELAMENTOS */
    SELECT
        DATE(DATA_OPERACAO) AS DIA,
        0, 0, 0,
        COUNT(*),
        0, 0, 0
    FROM ALTAREDE.AUDITORIA_CLIENTE
    WHERE OBS LIKE 'ALTERAÇÃO TIPO CLIENTE%'
      AND VALOR_ATUAL = '8'
      AND VALOR_ANTERIOR <> VALOR_ATUAL
      AND DATE(DATA_OPERACAO) >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
    GROUP BY DATE(DATA_OPERACAO)

    UNION ALL

    /* CANCELAMENTOS POR INADIMPLÊNCIA */
    SELECT
        DATE(DATA_OPERACAO) AS DIA,
        0, 0, 0, 0,
        COUNT(*),
        0, 0
    FROM ALTAREDE.AUDITORIA_CLIENTE
    WHERE OBS LIKE 'ALTERAÇÃO TIPO CLIENTE%'
      AND VALOR_ATUAL = '10'
      AND VALOR_ANTERIOR <> VALOR_ATUAL
      AND DATE(DATA_OPERACAO) >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
    GROUP BY DATE(DATA_OPERACAO)

    UNION ALL

    /* PAUSADOS */
    SELECT
        DATE(DATA_OPERACAO) AS DIA,
        0, 0, 0, 0, 0,
        COUNT(*),
        0
    FROM ALTAREDE.AUDITORIA_CLIENTE
    WHERE OBS LIKE 'ALTERAÇÃO TIPO CLIENTE%'
      AND VALOR_ATUAL = '9'
      AND VALOR_ANTERIOR <> VALOR_ATUAL
      AND DATE(DATA_OPERACAO) >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
    GROUP BY DATE(DATA_OPERACAO)

    UNION ALL

    /* PERMUTAS */
    SELECT
        DATE(DATA_OPERACAO) AS DIA,
        0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0,
        COUNT(*)
    FROM ALTAREDE.AUDITORIA_CLIENTE
    WHERE OBS LIKE 'ALTERAÇÃO TIPO CLIENTE%'
      AND VALOR_ATUAL = '2'
      AND VALOR_ANTERIOR <> VALOR_ATUAL
      AND DATE(DATA_OPERACAO) >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
    GROUP BY DATE(DATA_OPERACAO)

) AS MOVIMENTOS
GROUP BY DIA
ORDER BY DIA;

SELECT
    DATE_SUB(DATA_EVENTO, INTERVAL WEEKDAY(DATA_EVENTO) DAY) AS DIA,
    SUM(CADASTROS) AS CADASTROS,
    SUM(RETORNOS_ATIVO) AS RETORNOS_ATIVO,
    SUM(INADIMPLENCIAS) AS INADIMPLENCIAS,
    SUM(CANCELAMENTOS) AS CANCELAMENTOS,
    SUM(CANCELAMENTOS_INADIMPLENCIA) AS CANCELAMENTOS_INADIMPLENCIA,
    SUM(PAUSADOS) AS PAUSADOS,
    SUM(PERMUTAS) AS PERMUTAS
FROM (

    SELECT
        DATE(DATA_CADASTRO) AS DATA_EVENTO,
        1 AS CADASTROS,
        0 AS RETORNOS_ATIVO,
        0 AS INADIMPLENCIAS,
        0 AS CANCELAMENTOS,
        0 AS CANCELAMENTOS_INADIMPLENCIA,

        0 AS PERMUTAS
    FROM ALTAREDE.CLIENTE
    WHERE DATA_CADASTRO >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAY

    UNION ALL

      AND VALOR_ATUAL = '1'

    UNION ALL

    WHERE OBS LIKE 'ALTERAÇÃO TIPO CLIENTE%'

      AND VALOR_ANTERIOR <> VALOR_ATUAL
      AND DATE(DATA_OPERACAO) >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
    GROUP BY DATE(DATA_OPERACAO)

    UNION ALL

        DATE(DATA_OPERACAO),
        0, 0, 0, COUNT(*), 0, 0, 0
    FROM ALTAREDE.AUDITORIA_CLIENTE
    WHERE OBS LIKE 'ALTERAÇÃO TIPO CLIENTE%'
      AND VALOR_ATUAL = '8'
      AND VALOR_ANTERIOR <> VALOR_ATUAL
      AND DATE(DATA_OPERACAO) >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
    GROUP BY DATE(DATA_OPERACAO)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        DATE(DATA_OPERACAO),
        0, 0, 0, 0, COUNT(*), 0, 0
    FROM ALTAREDE.AUDITORIA_CLIENTE
    WHERE OBS LIKE 'ALTERAÇÃO TIPO CLIENTE%'
      AND VALOR_ATUAL = '10'
      AND VALOR_ANTERIOR <> VALOR_ATUAL
      AND DATE(DATA_OPERACAO) >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
    GROUP BY DATE(DATA_OPERACAO)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        DATE(DATA_OPERACAO),
        0, 0, 0, 0, 0, COUNT(*), 0
    FROM ALTAREDE.AUDITORIA_CLIENTE
    WHERE OBS LIKE 'ALTERAÇÃO TIPO CLIENTE%'
      AND VALOR_ATUAL = '9'
      AND VALOR_ANTERIOR <> VALOR_ATUAL
      AND DATE(DATA_OPERACAO) >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
    GROUP BY DATE(DATA_OPERACAO)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        DATE(DATA_OPERACAO),
        0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, COUNT(*)
    FROM ALTAREDE.AUDITORIA_CLIENTE
    WHERE OBS LIKE 'ALTERAÇÃO TIPO CLIENTE%'
      AND VALOR_ATUAL = '2'
      AND VALOR_ANTERIOR <> VALOR_ATUAL
      AND DATE(DATA_OPERACAO) >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
    GROUP BY DATE(DATA_OPERACAO)

) AS MOVIMENTOS
GROUP BY DATE_SUB(DATA_EVENTO, INTERVAL WEEKDAY(DATA_EVENTO) DAY)
ORDER BY DIA;

SELECT
    CAST(DATE_FORMAT(DATA_EVENTO, '%Y-%m-01') AS DATETIME) AS time,
    SUM(CADASTROS) AS CADASTROS,
    SUM(RETORNOS_ATIVO) AS RETORNOS_ATIVO,
    SUM(INADIMPLENCIAS) AS INADIMPLENCIAS,
    SUM(CANCELAMENTOS) AS CANCELAMENTOS,
    SUM(CANCELAMENTOS_INADIMPLENCIA) AS CANCELAMENTOS_INADIMPLENCIA,
    SUM(PAUSADOS) AS PAUSADOS,
    SUM(PERMUTAS) AS PERMUTAS
FROM (
    /* CADASTROS */
    SELECT
        DATE(DATA_CADASTRO) AS DATA_EVENTO,
        COUNT(*) AS CADASTROS,
        0 AS RETORNOS_ATIVO,
        0 AS INADIMPLENCIAS,
        0 AS CANCELAMENTOS,
        0 AS CANCELAMENTOS_INADIMPLENCIA,
        0 AS PAUSADOS,
        0 AS PERMUTAS
    FROM ALTAREDE.CLIENTE
    WHERE DATA_CADASTRO >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 360 DAY
    GROUP BY DATE(DATA_CADASTRO)

    UNION ALL

    /* RETORNOS ATIVO */
    SELECT DATE(DATA_OPERACAO), 0, COUNT(*), 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
    FROM ALTAREDE.AUDITORIA_CLIENTE
    WHERE OBS LIKE 'ALTERAÇÃO TIPO CLIENTE%'
      AND VALOR_ATUAL = '1'
      AND VALOR_ANTERIOR <> VALOR_ATUAL
      AND DATE(DATA_OPERACAO) >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 360 DAY
    GROUP BY DATE(DATA_OPERACAO)

    UNION ALL

    /* INADIMPLÊNCIAS */
    SELECT DATE(DATA_OPERACAO), 0, 0, COUNT(*), 0, 0, 0, 0
    FROM ALTAREDE.AUDITORIA_CLIENTE
    WHERE OBS LIKE 'ALTERAÇÃO TIPO CLIENTE%'
      AND VALOR_ATUAL = '3'
      AND VALOR_ANTERIOR <> VALOR_ATUAL
      AND DATE(DATA_OPERACAO) >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 360 DAY
    GROUP BY DATE(DATA_OPERACAO)

    UNION ALL

    /* CANCELAMENTOS */
    SELECT DATE(DATA_OPERACAO), 0, 0, 0, COUNT(*), 0, 0, 0
    FROM ALTAREDE.AUDITORIA_CLIENTE
    WHERE OBS LIKE 'ALTERAÇÃO TIPO CLIENTE%'
      AND VALOR_ATUAL = '8'
      AND VALOR_ANTERIOR <> VALOR_ATUAL
      AND DATE(DATA_OPERACAO) >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 360 DAY
    GROUP BY DATE(DATA_OPERACAO)

    UNION ALL

    /* CANCELAMENTOS POR INADIMPLÊNCIA */
    SELECT DATE(DATA_OPERACAO), 0, 0, 0, 0, COUNT(*), 0, 0
    FROM ALTAREDE.AUDITORIA_CLIENTE
    WHERE OBS LIKE 'ALTERAÇÃO TIPO CLIENTE%'
      AND VALOR_ATUAL = '10'
      AND VALOR_ANTERIOR <> VALOR_ATUAL
      AND DATE(DATA_OPERACAO) >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 360 DAY
    GROUP BY DATE(DATA_OPERACAO)

    UNION ALL

    /* PAUSADOS */
    SELECT DATE(DATA_OPERACAO), 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, COUNT(*), 0
    FROM ALTAREDE.AUDITORIA_CLIENTE
    WHERE OBS LIKE 'ALTERAÇÃO TIPO CLIENTE%'
      AND VALOR_ATUAL = '9'
      AND VALOR_ANTERIOR <> VALOR_ATUAL
      AND DATE(DATA_OPERACAO) >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 360 DAY
    GROUP BY DATE(DATA_OPERACAO)

    UNION ALL

    /* PERMUTAS */
    SELECT DATE(DATA_OPERACAO), 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, COUNT(*)
    FROM ALTAREDE.AUDITORIA_CLIENTE
    WHERE OBS LIKE 'ALTERAÇÃO TIPO CLIENTE%'
      AND VALOR_ATUAL = '2'
      AND VALOR_ANTERIOR <> VALOR_ATUAL
      AND DATE(DATA_OPERACAO) >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 360 DAY
    GROUP BY DATE(DATA_OPERACAO)

) AS MOVIMENTOS
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(DATA_EVENTO, '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY time;

SELECT
    UNIX_TIMESTAMP(X.MES) AS time,

    SUM(CASE
        WHEN X.STATUS_FINAL IN ('1', '2') THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END) AS ATIVOS,

    SUM(CASE
        WHEN X.STATUS_FINAL = '3' THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END) AS INADIMPLENTES,

    SUM(CASE
        WHEN X.STATUS_FINAL IN ('8', '10') THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END) AS CANCELADOS,

    SUM(CASE
        WHEN X.STATUS_FINAL = '9' THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END) AS PAUSADOS,

    COUNT(*) AS TOTAL

FROM
(
    SELECT
        M.MES,
        C.COD_CLIENTE,

        COALESCE(
            (
                SELECT A.VALOR_ATUAL
                FROM ALTAREDE.AUDITORIA_CLIENTE A
                WHERE A.COD_CLIENTE = C.COD_CLIENTE
                  AND A.OBS LIKE 'ALTERAÇÃO TIPO CLIENTE%'
                  AND A.DATA_OPERACAO < DATE_ADD(M.MES, INTERVAL 1 MONTH)

                ORDER BY
                    A.DATA_OPERACAO DESC,
                    A.HORA_OPERACAO DESC,
                    A.ID DESC

                LIMIT 1
            ),
            CAST(C.COD_TIPOCLIENTE AS CHAR)
        ) AS STATUS_FINAL

    FROM
    (
        SELECT DATE_FORMAT(
            DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 11 MONTH),
            '%Y-%m-01'
        ) AS MES

        UNION ALL

        SELECT DATE_FORMAT(
            DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 10 MONTH),
            '%Y-%m-01'
        )

        UNION ALL

        SELECT DATE_FORMAT(
            DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 9 MONTH),
            '%Y-%m-01'
        )

        UNION ALL

        SELECT DATE_FORMAT(
            DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 8 MONTH),
            '%Y-%m-01'
        )

        UNION ALL

        SELECT DATE_FORMAT(
            DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 MONTH),
            '%Y-%m-01'
        )

        UNION ALL

        SELECT DATE_FORMAT(
            DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH),
            '%Y-%m-01'
        )

        UNION ALL

        SELECT DATE_FORMAT(
            DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 5 MONTH),
            '%Y-%m-01'
        )

        UNION ALL

        SELECT DATE_FORMAT(
            DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 4 MONTH),
            '%Y-%m-01'
        )

        UNION ALL

        SELECT DATE_FORMAT(
            DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH),
            '%Y-%m-01'
        )

        UNION ALL

        SELECT DATE_FORMAT(
            DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 2 MONTH),
            '%Y-%m-01'
        )

        UNION ALL

        SELECT DATE_FORMAT(
            DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH),
            '%Y-%m-01'
        )

        UNION ALL

        SELECT DATE_FORMAT(
            CURDATE(),
            '%Y-%m-01'
        )
    ) M

    INNER JOIN ALTAREDE.CLIENTE C
        ON C.DATA_CADASTRO < DATE_ADD(M.MES, INTERVAL 1 MONTH)

) X

GROUP BY X.MES

ORDER BY X.MES;
